resources.string: Delete the selected nodes and their descendants? The central topic and original files will be kept. You can undo this operation.
Tap to toggle nodes. Drag blank space to select a group, or drag a selected node to move the group. Use two fingers to pan and zoom. Leave node selection to write or lasso ink.
Duplicate or invalid relationship; existing data kept.
Choose a whole file or a permanent page reference. Open a specific source to locate its note or PDF page, then use Return to map. Map backups do not include source files.
Source unavailable, missing identity or duplicate identity. Open or repair the original in the file browser first. No source content was changed.
The canvas shows the proposed layout. Confirm to apply as one undo step; cancel to keep original positions. Free nodes stay in place.
Each stroke is saved to the graph. Back restores the graph view; undo works across both views.
Edit the name or paper size here. Write directly in the node or use Enlarge edit. Resizing paper does not scale ink.
The relationship or an endpoint changed. Return to the list and reopen it; the draft was not applied.
This relationship already exists. It is now open below. Neither existing line was changed.
Drag to a target node, or tap one, then confirm the relationship. Two fingers return to view gestures.
Create a free node here, with an undirected relationship to %1$s.
The starting node or document changed. Cancel and start a new connection.
Reference a file or a page. Map backups do not include the original files.
Sources changed, or the document limit was reached. Review the list and retry.
Choose a page from the current file. Thumbnails are not available yet.
This writes permanent page IDs to the selected source file. Original handwriting and PDF bytes are preserved. Existing editors may need to reopen the file. Continue?
The source or graph changed. Cancel and choose the source again; no reference was added.
Page enabling could not be completed. The source may already contain the written version; retained recovery data is kept. Continue explicitly, or cancel and choose the source again.
The preview could not be refreshed. The last image is kept.
Last preview of the previous reference range
Previews do not back up source files. Whole-note and PDF previews show the first page.
Save this note first, then reference the desired page again.
Save an independent copy of these changes, then reference the saved page again. The original source stays unchanged.
This note needs page references enabled. Enabling saves permanent page IDs. Reopen the file afterwards, then reference the desired page again. Existing ink and PDF content are kept.
The file was reopened. Reference the desired page again.
Reopen the file to identify the page reliably, then reference the desired page again. The current document stays open if reopening fails.
Add this page to an existing map or create a map. Reading stays in this pane.
Choose a concept below, or create a reference node. Existing node content is kept.
This map has recovery data or a save conflict. Open the map to review it; no conflict is overwritten automatically.
Waiting for the pen in the destination map…
Finish text editing in the map before adding a branch. You can still attach this page to an existing node or create a free node.
The reference was added and saved.
The map also has newer unsaved changes.
The reference is in the current map session, but saving did not complete. Retry saving or open the map to resolve the problem. Retrying does not add the reference again.
Map creation did not finish. Retained data is kept for this target. Continue with this same map or open it to review recovery; do not create it again.
The page or source changed, or cannot be read now. Retry; if needed, reopen the note and reference the page again.
The target map changed or is unavailable. Choose it again or open it to review. Reading remains unchanged.
An import is waiting. Close this map to continue.
The referenced page is open. The saved region is outside the current page.
Opened the existing note, including its unsaved changes.
The referenced page was deleted. The map and last preview are kept.
More than one source has this identity. Resolve the duplicate before opening.
An edit is still in progress. Finish it and retry opening the source.
The source or workspace changed. Review the source and retry.
Opening canvas and map sources is not available yet. The reference is kept.
The source could not be opened. Check its identity, permission or original PDF in the file browser. The map is kept.
The outgoing note could not be saved. The map is kept. Review the save problem and retry opening the source.
Checks the authorized library locations. Source status and previews come from the map’s last record; this lookup does not reread note or PDF content.
Some locations could not be checked. This list may be incomplete.
No references were found in the checked locations.
No references were found in the available results. Other locations remain unchecked.
This note has no permanent page references yet. Whole-file references can still be checked.
The page identity cannot be verified. Page matches are unavailable; whole-file references can still be checked.
Open an identified note or PDF annotation document to check its references.
From the current map session, including unsaved changes
Remove this source from the map?

Map: %1$s
Node: %2$s
Source: %3$s
Range: %4$s

Only this source is removed from this node. The node body, other sources and original file are kept.
The source was removed from this map session. Saving the map…
The source was removed and the map was saved.
The removal was saved. The map also has newer unsaved changes.
Maps excluded from reserved or trash locations: %1$d
View the node in the map
The saved preview could not be loaded.
The map is not accessible. Check its location or permission.
The map or its recovery data could not be read. Existing data is kept.
The map has conflicting recovery data. Open it normally to review recovery first.
Different map files share this identity. Resolve the duplicate before changing a reference.
The map identity does not match this reference. Check the file again.
The map is still opening or changing. Check again when it is ready.
The lookup reached its size limit. Some locations or previews remain unchecked.
The page, map or reference changed. Check again before continuing.
An edit is in progress in the map. Finish the edit and try again.
The source was removed in the current session, but saving did not finish. Retrying saves the map without removing again. You can open the node to review or undo.
This map is in the recycle bin. Restore it before changing its references.
This map’s location could not be confirmed as outside reserved or trash folders. Check its location before editing.
Reference checking was stopped. The results may be incomplete.
The map was saved. The reference changed after removal; review the node in the map.
The map was saved, and has newer unsaved changes. The reference changed after removal; review the node in the map.
Read-only file relationship network. Select a node or connection to inspect its references.
Content references connect concepts to their source files. Sharing a concept does not mean the files reference or depend on each other. Names and source states are the last recorded values.
This concept belongs to its map. This is separate from the content sources below.
Choose a specific source to open the concept and that exact source in its map.
No concept references this file in the checked locations.
Open this reference in its map
An import is waiting. Close the relationship network to continue.
Opening the selected reference. The diagram is held while current sources are checked.

Conditions apply to source files, using their last identified format and registered location. Included concepts keep all their sources; other files remain as context. These details do not verify the current source identity.
Waiting for the folder picker. Results from a canceled draft will be ignored.
The folder could not be selected. Try again.
Format or location could not be determined for %1$d source files. Results may be incomplete.
Context retained with the concept; not a confirmed filter match.
The filter changed. Close and reopen this dialog to edit it.
No concepts match the current filter.
Direct relationships of the center file stay visible.
Kept as context for the path to a matching concept.
Reached through a source in %1$s · level %2$d
Reached through concepts belonging to %1$s · level %2$d
Choose up to 250 known files by identity. Names and registered locations are last-known details. Existing source filters stay applied.
The network scope changed or a selected file is no longer available. Close and reopen this dialog, or clear the selection.
View the library to choose from known files across your authorized folders. Canceling this dialog keeps the current neighborhood.
No known files are available in this inventory. Refresh the library to check again.
Known files and content references in authorized folders
No files or references to display
No content references to this file are displayed in the current view.
No content references are displayed in the current view.
